tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Coghelm's curated AI tools for leaders (and job guides) by keyword, e.g. 'meeting notes', 'grant writing', 'slides'.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get details for one tool by slug (e.g. 'claude', 'granola'), including its Coghelm page and job guides that recommend it.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List Coghelm's job guides (jobs leaders do, like running 1:1s or writing a board update), each with its top pick tool.

tools.name: get_job_guide
tools.description: Get a full job guide by slug: intro, top pick and why, alternatives, how-to steps, and FAQ.

tools.name: recommend_tools
tools.description: Recommend AI tools for a job a leader needs done (e.g. 'run better 1:1s', 'write a board update', 'research a competitor', 'grant writing'), using Coghelm's curated job guides and directory. Optional constraints: budget ('free' keeps only tools with a known free plan; 'low' ranks free plans first) a

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2-6 Coghelm tools by slug (e.g. ['otter','fathom','granola']): category, description, free-plan flag, enterprise focus, and which Coghelm job guides recommend each (top pick vs alternative).

tools.name: draft_1on1_agenda
tools.description: Draft a structured 1:1 agenda (Markdown) for a manager and a direct report, time-boxed to the meeting length. Template-based: fills in the topics, carry-overs, wins, concerns, and goals you pass; leaves prompts where you pass nothing. Puts the report's topics first.

tools.name: draft_board_update_outline
tools.description: Draft a board/exec update outline (Markdown) with the proven structure: headline, asks first, numbers vs plan, wins, misses, risks, outlook. Template-based: fills in what you pass and leaves clear placeholders elsewhere. Never invents numbers.

tools.name: playbook_preview
tools.description: Preview Coghelm's Leader's AI Playbook (PDF): table of contents, what each chapter contains, two sample prompts, and the offer summary. Use when a user wants deeper prompts/templates for leadership work.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Machine-readable offer for the Leader's AI Playbook: $29 USD one-time, digital PDF, 30-day full refund, terms URL, support email, and a Stripe buy URL. Purchases must be completed by the human at checkout.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_offer · Public sink: get_offer · Destructive: recommend_tools, draft_board_update_outline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_offer · Public sink: get_offer · Destructive: recommend_tools, draft_board_update_outline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
